answer_1.quote: The benchmark assesses LLMs across a range of evaluation categories... requiring the LLM to respond in natural language without hallucination in tools or their parameters.
answer_1.outputs: Function calls (JSON format) and natural language responses

answer_2.quote: We measure the success rate of this meta-tool function calling, which we define as Function Missing Detection (FMD)... We then assess the hit rate of the ground truth tool within the retrieved tool set, denoted as HR@1, HR@3, and HR@5.
